def design(feats):
    X = np.asarray(feats.x, float); y = np.asarray(feats.y, float); n, p = X.shape
    ids = list(feats.ids); labs = sorted(set(feats.stratum))
    S = np.array([[1.0 * (s == l) for l in labs[1:]] for s in feats.stratum]).reshape(n, -1)
    base = np.column_stack([np.ones(n), S])
    R = np.corrcoef(X.T); R = np.nan_to_num(R)
    def ll(Z):
        b = np.zeros(Z.shape[1])
        for _ in range(30):
            eta = np.clip(Z @ b, -30, 30); mu = 1 / (1 + np.exp(-eta)); w = mu * (1 - mu) + 1e-9
            H = Z.T @ (Z * w[:, None]) + 1e-6 * np.eye(Z.shape[1])
            step = np.linalg.solve(H, Z.T @ (y - mu)); b += step
            if np.max(np.abs(step)) < 1e-7: break
        mu = np.clip(1 / (1 + np.exp(-np.clip(Z @ b, -30, 30))), 1e-12, 1 - 1e-12)
        return float(np.sum(y * np.log(mu) + (1 - y) * np.log(1 - mu)))
    def col(t):
        return X[:, t] if not isinstance(t, tuple) else X[:, t[0]] * X[:, t[1]]
    def fit(terms):
        return ll(np.column_stack([base] + [col(t) for t in terms]))
    sel = []; cur = fit([])
    gates = [0.25 / p, 0.1 / p, 0.03 / p]
    while len(sel) < MAX_DRIVERS:
        cand = [j for j in range(p) if j not in sel and all(abs(R[j, k]) < 0.6 for k in sel)]
        if not cand: break
        lls = np.array([fit(sel + [j]) for j in cand])
        bi = int(np.argmax(lls)); j = cand[bi]
        pv = stats.chi2.sf(2 * (lls[bi] - cur), 1)
        if pv > gates[min(len(sel), len(gates) - 1)]: break
        clus = [k for k in cand if abs(R[j, k]) >= 0.6]
        near = [k for k in clus if lls[cand.index(k)] >= lls[bi] - 2]
        j = max(near, key=lambda k: np.sum(R[k, clus] ** 2))
        sel.append(j); cur = fit(sel)
    changed = True
    while changed and sel:
        changed = False
        for j in list(sel):
            rest = [k for k in sel if k != j]
            if stats.chi2.sf(2 * (cur - fit(rest)), 1) > (0.25 if len(sel) == 1 else 0.1) / p:
                sel = rest; cur = fit(sel); changed = True; break
    # product / square screen over all pairs
    Z0 = np.column_stack([base] + [X[:, k] for k in sel])
    b = np.zeros(Z0.shape[1])
    for _ in range(30):
        mu = 1 / (1 + np.exp(-np.clip(Z0 @ b, -30, 30))); w = mu * (1 - mu) + 1e-9
        b += np.linalg.solve(Z0.T @ (Z0 * w[:, None]) + 1e-6 * np.eye(Z0.shape[1]), Z0.T @ (y - mu))
    mu = 1 / (1 + np.exp(-np.clip(Z0 @ b, -30, 30))); w = mu * (1 - mu); r = y - mu
    pairs = [(a, c) for a in range(p) for c in range(a, p)]
    P = np.column_stack([X[:, a] * X[:, c] for a, c in pairs])
    sc = (r @ P) ** 2 / (w @ (P ** 2) + 1e-9)
    prods = []; npair = len(pairs)
    for i in np.argsort(-sc)[:15]:
        a, c = pairs[i]
        if any(len({a, c} & set(q)) for q in prods) or len(prods) >= 2: continue
        mains = sorted(set(sel) | {a, c}, key=lambda k: k)
        l1 = fit(mains + prods + [(a, c)]); l0 = fit(mains + prods)
        if stats.chi2.sf(2 * (l1 - l0), 1) < 0.01 / npair:
            prods.append((a, c))
    if prods:
        pk = {k for q in prods for k in q}
        for j in list(sel):
            if j in pk: continue
            rest = [k for k in sel if k != j]
            if stats.chi2.sf(2 * (fit(sel + prods) - fit(rest + prods)), 1) > 0.03 / p: sel = rest
    drv = list(sel)
    for a, c in prods:
        for k in (a, c):
            if k not in drv: drv.append(k)
    drv = drv[:MAX_DRIVERS]
    cols = sorted(set(drv) | {k for q in prods for k in q})
    return Design(drivers=tuple(ids[k] for k in drv), columns=tuple(ids[k] for k in cols),
                  products=tuple((ids[a], ids[c]) for a, c in prods), loadings={})
